specification.title: Inconclusive sparse evidence is not turned into a verdict
specification.description: Inconclusive / sparse evidence: an INCONCLUSIVE/low Assessment with no findings. The report must preserve the inconclusive verdict, retain the limitation and unresolved question, and must not infer a benign verdict from the absence of hits. With no supplied findings or research claims, no narrative statement is authored.
specification.purpose: Verify an INCONCLUSIVE Assessment with no findings is reported as inconclusive with its limitation and unresolved question, never as benign.
specification.operational_relevance: Honest inconclusive reporting preserves uncertainty instead of false-clearing infrastructure.
specification.regression_risk: The writer could infer a benign verdict from the absence of findings or drop the unresolved question.

required: The report preserves the inconclusive verdict and low confidence
The report retains the required limitation and unresolved question
forbidden: The report emits a benign verdict
The report invents findings from absent evidence

required_unresolved_questions: why no reputation data was retrieved
